title: Rampaging Minotaur
description: A muscular purple minotaur with blue hair and horns charges forward from a shattered stone floor, mouth open in a roar. Broken chains dangle from its wrists and neck as it emerges from an underground ruin with dramatic golden light rays streaming down from above.
prompt: A powerful muscular purple minotaur with bright blue hair, large curved horns, and glowing red eyes charges aggressively out of an underground temple ruin. Broken metal chains hang from its wrists and neck, mouth open in a furious roar. Dramatic golden god rays shine down through a broken ceiling onto swirling dust and cracked stone tiles, with faint blue demonic spirits floating in the background.
